mapper.select: SELECT event.id, event.assignment_id, event.student_id, event.practice_task_id, event.progress_status, event.score, event.correct_count, event.total_count, event.started_at, event.submitted_at, event.graded_at, event.delivery_status, event.retry_count, event.next_retry_at, event.synced_at, event.last_error, event.created_at, event.updated_at FROM assignment_sync_event event WHERE event.delivery_status = 'PENDING' AND event.next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM assignment_sync_event earlier WHERE earlier.practice_task_id = event.practice_task_id AND earlier.delivery_status = 'PENDING' AND ( earlier.created_at < event.created_at OR (earlier.created_at = event.created_at AND earlier.id < event.id) ) ) ORDER BY event.created_at, event.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF event SKIP LOCKED
